Why I Build Stuff

Whether I'm fixing a bug, cutting wood joints, or framing a shot—it's all the same process: figure out the problem, grab the right tools, try stuff until it works.

Everything connects. Woodworking taught me patience for debugging. Photography made me pickier about details. Coding logic applies everywhere.
